label: Вспомнить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for вспомнить (to recall, recollect).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. 'Вспомню' is the simple future of perfective вспомнить, needing no auxiliary. It marks one completed act of recollection.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Вспомнишь' shows the -ишь ending of вспомнить. The perfective points to one moment when memory returns.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Вспомнит' is the simple future marking a single recollection. Its imperfective partner вспоминать describes recurring reminiscence.

missions.phrase: Мы вспомним этот вечер с улыбкой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Вспомним' takes the -им ending and promises one act of remembering. 'С улыбкой' adds an instrumental of manner.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Вспомните' is the respectful -ите future form. 'Потом' anchors the future moment of recall.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Вспомнил' is the masculine -л past, marking a sudden completed recollection. 'Вдруг' captures the abruptness of remembering.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Вспомнила' adds the feminine -ла ending. 'Старую подругу' is the accusative object of a single recollection.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Вспомнили' is the plural -ли past for all genders. 'Смешную историю' is the accusative object of a completed memory.

Strategic focus: Perfective infinitive. 'Вспомнить' stays infinitive after the modal 'не могу'. The perfective stresses one failed attempt to recall; imperfective вспоминать would mark ongoing effort.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Вспомни' is the informal command of вспомнить, urging one act of recollection. It contrasts with imperfective вспоминай for repeated reminiscing.
